layers.text: Change only two things: erase the four tiny coloured dots in the corners of the image so the corners are empty and transparent; and recolour the stitched crack down the tooth into one plain dark chocolate brown #4a2412 zigzag crack line. Keep the white tooth, its two roots, its grey shading, the white sparkle star, the thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
